items.title: Analog Devices (ADI) Draws Fresh ETF Buying, Is The Stock Already Pricey?
items.summary: ETF flows have swung sharply toward Analog Devices (ADI) after semiconductor funds led by SOXX bought a net $311.1 million of the stock on November 9, reversing recent outflows. That ETF interest lands on a stock that has already been in motion, with Analog Devices trading at $409.29 after a 7 day share price return of 13.37%, while the 1 year total shareholder return of 74.47% indicates notable momentum even after a recent 30 day share price dip of 1.30%. items.title: Analog Devices (ADI) Stock Looks Fully Valued As It Buys Into AI
items.summary: Analog Devices has ridden a strong run in recent years, and at a last close of US$409.29 the stock now invites a closer look at whether that price is properly anchored to its earnings power. With sentiment also tied to the broader semiconductor story, the question is how much of that optimism is already embedded in the multiple investors are paying today.
